verdict.rationale: Otter's own docs describe an official MCP Server that connects meeting data to Claude, ChatGPT and other AI chat tools. The documented scope covers searching transcripts, action items and recaps, and access is OAuth-authenticated with granular per-meeting authorization, so no glue code is needed. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that it works with arbitrary MCP clients, and detailed first-party setup or tool-reference documentation beyond marketing and blog copy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an official MCP server lets Claude or any MCP client query my meetings — search, transcripts, action items — with OAuth, no glue code

citations.quote: ChatGPT, Claude, and other AI chat tools can securely access your meeting knowledge through Otter's MCP Server for deeper analysis and smarter workflows.
Connect Otter.ai meeting transcripts and action items to Claude via MCP. Search, recap, and draft follow-ups without leaving the chat.
Search your meeting transcripts across all time periods
OAuth-authenticated with granular permissions. Your AI assistant can only access meetings you explicitly authorize
